LanguageData.HE_Roma_Puls.label: puls
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Puls.description: A thick porridge of grain and beans with olive oil and herbs. The legions marched on it for centuries.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Lucanica.label: lucanica and bread
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Lucanica.description: A coil of smoked pork sausage spiced with pepper, cumin and rue, served with a round of bread. Legionaries carried it on the march.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Libum.label: libum
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Libum.description: A cheese cake baked on bay leaves and glazed with honey, offered at festivals and eaten with great ceremony afterwards. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
